description: dryvist/.github default Renovate config — the org-wide entry point consumers get via `extends: ["local>dryvist/.github"]` (or `github>dryvist/.github`).

dryvist/.github is the MASTER source of truth for Renovate policy across ALL dryvist AND JacobPEvans repos. It extends no other repository's config — only Renovate's built-in `config:recommended` baseline and dryvist's own local presets. JacobPEvans/.github extends THIS, never the reverse. All policy (auto-merge, trusted orgs, grouping, custom managers including the Ansible Docker-image manager) lives in renovate-presets.json + renovate-grouping.json in this repo.
